snippet.title: Mahiya (Official Music Video) Badshah x Shreya Ghoshal - Mahiya ft. Avneet Kaur
snippet.description:
Something very special to my heart is yours now! The collaboration I’ve been waiting for for so long is finally here. Mahiya has always been so close to my heart, and now it’s yours too.
It’s all Shreya Ma’am, Avneet and now YOU!

Give it all the love you can. ❤️

#Mahiya #shreyaghoshal #badshah #avneetkaur #romanticsong 

Audio Credits :- 
➟ Singer : Badshah, Shreya Ghoshal 
➟ Lyrics : Badshah
➟ Composed : Badshah 
➟ Music Produced : Hiten
➟ Mixed & Mastered : Hanish Taneja
➟ Sarangi : Momin Khan
➟ Guitars- Rhythm Shaw

Lyrics :- 
Mahiya Yeh jhumke bindiya chura ke nindiya le jayenge teri,
O piya, tujhe hi dil diya haan kaun iss tarah ho jayegi teri?

Teri aankhein bataye ke tu soyi nahi hai,
Sukoon humko bhi nahi hai,
Mujhe dekh ke shayad lage naa tujhe,
Par aashiq mere jaisa koi nahi hai.
Wajib bechainiyan hai teri,
Mujh mein bhi khaamiyan batheri,
Chahe jahan bhi jau dikhe,
Mujh pe nishaaniyan hai teri.
Joh tu na dikhe toh ye aankhein kis kaam ki?
Zikr na tera toh ye baatein kis kaam ki?
Fikr na kisi bhi baat ki,
Kar tu khaamakha,
Bina raani ke badshah kis kaam ka?

Mahiya Yeh jhumke bindiya chura ke nindiya le jayenge teri,
O piya, tujhe hi dil diya haan kaun iss tarah ho jayegi teri?

Sukoon denge, Sanak denge, Zameen denge, Falak denge
Joh maangega tu haske jaan, tere hanthon me rakh denge.
Bekhabar, rakh thodi si khabar, Kari na jo qadar, hojayegi deri.

Teri parchaayi main banu,
Tanhai main jarun,
Teri aahein main bharu.
Maine maanga tujhe, lagi aake mujhe,
Kisi dua ke jaise tu,
Teri parchaayi main banu,
Tanhai main jarun,
Teri aahein main bharu.
Maine maanga tujhe, lagi aake mujhe,
Kisi dua ke jaise tu,

Rahe na kisi bhi kaam ke,
Jab se bane hain deewane tere naam ke,
Its your boy
jo meri bani hai jaan,
Aave le na chahti jaan meri jaan ke,
Ho jaaye tere...

snippet.title: धूल माथे लगाई तिलक हो गया (Lyrics) | Dhool Mathe Lagai Tilak Ho Gaya | Bhasm Shiv Bhajan
snippet.description:
धूल माथे लगाई तिलक हो गया (Lyrics) | Dhool Mathe Lagai Tilak Ho Gaya | Bhasm Shiv Bhajan

Dhool Mathe Lagai Tilak Ho Gaya (Bhasm Tan Par Rami, Shiv Se Milkar Main Shiv Ho Gaya) – Soulful Acoustic Shiv Bhajan with Sarangi, by Shiv Raga.

धूल माथे लगाई तिलक हो गया, दर्द को स्वर मिला तो भजन हो गया – शिव से मिलकर के मैं शिव हो गया 🔱

▶ Shiv & Mahadev bhajans:

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLN1UKEI0US4b3ja8cuuMPUP7m2cbyczzx&si=-6bX1TSyd2ZAHkuV

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLN1UKEI0US4alIDjnQFsxzj9rizE1MDbh&si=AXl9ELq-JnYcbnDE

Dhool Mathe Lagai Tilak Ho Gaya is a soulful, meditative Hindi Shiv bhajan by Shiv Raga, set to acoustic guitar and sarangi. From the ghats of Kashi to the bhasm aarti of Mahakal, this devotional song sings of the moment a devotee smears sacred ash, loses the fear of death, and becomes one with Mahadev. Perfect for Dev Deepawali, Kartik Purnima, Shivratri and every Somvar.

⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00 धूल माथे लगाई तिलक हो गया (परिचय)
0:14 धूल माथे लगाई, टूटा सारा भरम (अंतरा 1)
0:40 भस्म तन पर रमी, ये असर हो गया (मुखड़ा)
1:20 घाट की सीढ़ियों पर नमन हो गया (अंतरा 2)
2:13 डम डमा डम बजा, मन गगन हो गया (अंतरा 3)
3:06 मैं जिसे मैं कहूँ, वो दहन हो गया (अंतरा 4)
3:32 शिव से मिलकर के मैं शिव हो गया (समापन)

📖 LYRICS | बोल

भस्म तन पर रमी ये असर हो गया / काल का भय मिटा मैं अमर हो गया / साँस की लौ जो ईश्वर से जा मिली / शिव से मिलकर के मैं शिव हो गया
Bhasm tan par rami ye asar ho gaya / Kaal ka bhay mita main amar ho gaya / Saans ki lau jo Ishwar se ja mili / Shiv se milkar ke main Shiv ho gaya

[1] धूल माथे लगाई तिलक हो गया / टूटा सारा भरम मन सरल हो गया / मौन मेरा यहाँ प्रार्थना बन गया / दर्द को स्वर मिला तो भजन हो गया
Dhool maathe lagaai tilak ho gaya / Toota saara bharam man saral ho gaya / Maun mera yahan prarthana ban gaya / Dard ko swar mila to bhajan ho gaya

[2] घाट की सीढ़ियों पर नमन हो गया / भस्म की आरती में मगन हो गया / राख जलती चिता की जो माथे लगी / मृत्यु का भी वहीं पर हवन हो गया
Ghaat ki seedhiyon par naman ho gaya / Bhasm ki aarti mein magan ho gaya / Raakh jalti chita ki jo maathe lagi / Mrityu ka bhi wahin par havan ho gaya

[3] डम डमा डम बजा मन गगन हो गया / बंद पलकों में शिव का दरस हो गया / धार गंगा की जो उन जटाओं में थी / आँख का नीर ही आचमन हो गया
Dam dama dam baja man gagan ho gaya / Band palkon mein Shiv ka daras ho gaya / Dhaar Ganga ki jo un jataon mein thi / Aankh ka neer hi aachman ho gaya

[4] मैं जिसे मैं कहूँ वो दहन हो गया / दूर कैलाश था अब निकट हो गया / जिसको ढूँढा किया उम्र भर दर-बदर / वो मेरे ही हृदय में प्रकट हो गया
Main jise main kahoon wo dahan ho gaya / Door Kailash tha ab nikat ho gaya / Jisko dhoondha kiya umr bhar dar-badar / Wo mere hi hriday mein prakat ho gaya

snippet.title: Rama Rama - Rishab Rikhiram Sharma (Official Music Video) | Sitar for Mental Health
snippet.description:
Rama Rama – Rishab Rikhiram Sharma | Official Music Video | OUT NOW

After the overwhelming love and countless requests following my performance at the Ramayan trailer launch (Pratham Sankalp), I humbly present to you “Rama Rama” - a timeless melody and my heartfelt offering of devotion.

Inspired by timeless stories of love, faith and the bond between the Lord and His devotees.

Shabari’s devotion to Lord Rama is a beautiful expression of this bond. She waited for years with unwavering faith, preparing for the day He would visit her. In a beloved popular retelling, when Lord Rama finally arrived, she offered Him berries, tasting each one first to ensure it was sweet. Lord Rama lovingly accepted her offering, recognising the sincerity and devotion behind it. Her story reminds us that the simplest offering, made with a pure heart, can hold the deepest meaning.

Another cherished devotional tradition connects Lord Rama, Lord Krishna and the sacred land of Braj. Hanuman was carrying Mount Govardhan to help Lord Rama build the Ram Setu. Before he could reach the ocean, the Vanara Sena had completed the bridge. Instructed to set the mountain down, Hanuman placed Govardhan in the Braj region.

Govardhan was deeply saddened to have missed the opportunity to serve Lord Rama. Moved by his devotion, Lord Rama promised that in His incarnation as Shri Krishna, He would return to Braj and lift Govardhan Himself.

The promise was fulfilled when Shri Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill on His little finger for seven days and nights, sheltering the people and cattle of Braj from Indra’s torrential rains—a gesture of divine protection and enduring love.

Near Govardhan Hill lies Kusum Sarovar, a sacred lake in the Mathura district of Uttar Pradesh. Traditionally associated with Radha and Krishna, its flowering groves evoke their divine presence. “Kusum” means “flower”—a fitting name for a place where natural beauty and devotion meet.

From Shabari’s patient love to Govardhan’s wish to serve, these stories share a simple belief: sincere devotion is always received.

I hope “Rama Rama” brings you a moment of peace, a feeling of connection and space to lose yourself in devotion.
